title: Vintage Retreat | Pecan Belle Cottage
description:
Pecan Belle is a two-bedroom, character-filled 1950s cottage made for unwinding, gathering, and feeling at home. Enjoy curated vintage details, slow mornings on the porch, evenings by the fire pit, and a peaceful backyard with its namesake pecan tree and creek. Just 10–15 minutes from Nashville’s top attractions and moments from Riverside Village’s beloved dining and drinks. Layout details are below. ⬇️

The space
You’ll have the entire main house and backyard to yourself. The lower level is a separate private residence with its own entrance, and there are no shared indoor living spaces.

INTENTIONAL DESIGN
• 2 bedrooms with king beds
• Bonus room for a kids’ play area, office, or second living room
• Vintage bathroom plus extra get-ready areas
• Covered front porch with lounge seating
• Large backyard with fire pit, picnic tables, and small creek
• Parking area for up to 3 vehicles

EXCELLENT LOCATION
• ½-mile walk (hilly) to Riverside Village dining & drinks
• 5 min to Shelby Bottoms Greenway
• 10–15 min to Downtown, Broadway & major venues
• 12 min to Grand Ole Opry & Opryland
• 15 min to Nashville Airport

AMENITIES
• 2 Roku Smart TVs: living room and primary bedroom 
• Fully equipped kitchen 
• Coffee, tea, half & half, sugar, olive oil & spices
• Fresh white bed linens and towels 
• Bathroom toiletries and hair dryer
• Fast fiber WiFi
• Blackout curtains in all sleeping areas
• Washer/dryer in garage (shared access with lower-level residence)
• WeberQ propane grill 

FAMILY-FRIENDLY DETAILS
• Pack ’n play
• High chair/booster seat
• Baby gate
• Kids’ dishware, toys, and books
• Sound machine and baby monitor
• Games for all ages
• Bathtub (add-on grab bar and suction mat available for safety)

Guest access
• Full access to the private main house and backyard
• Lower level is a separate residence with its own entrance
• Laundry in the garage is the only shared area
• If extra space is needed, the attic bedroom is included in our other listing: https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/1221129145688233404

Other things to note
• Rental agreement is required within 48 hours of booking (standard for many short-term rentals)
• The front door is a short uphill walk (~100 ft) from the parking area
• Exterior security cameras are located at the front and back doors
